payload.claim: The spec declares `risk: standard`, but both touched files (`saffron/cell/session.py`, `saffron/cell/worktree.py`) sit under `saffron/cell/**`, which is in `.saffron/policy.yaml`'s `elevate_on` list. Per DESIGN.md §5.6, this auto-elevates the effective risk to `elevated` regardless of the declared tier, making `size` blocking rather than advisory for this run. This has no practical consequence here since the prototype's measured 557 changed tokens outside `tests/**` stays well under the 1300-token `bug` ceiling, and `witness` already blocks at every risk tier per the already-landed SA-0288 fix. Purely informational: the queue entry will read `elevated` though the frontmatter says `standard`.
